summary.en: The definition chooses the comparison before any return is calculated.
summary.zh: 在计算收益以前，定义已经决定了比较对象。

question.en: Does the smallest company mean the same thing across markets?
question.zh: 不同市场的最小公司，是同一种研究对象吗？

conclusion.en: Dollar capitalization and within-market ranks answer different questions. Neither is a universal small-cap definition.
conclusion.zh: 美元市值与市场内排名回答不同问题，均不是通用的小盘定义。

paragraphs.en: An investor looking for overlooked businesses may call a company small because analysts rarely cover it. A portfolio researcher needs a rule that another person can repeat: a dollar threshold, a percentile or the smallest fixed number of eligible listings. These rules select different businesses, even on the same day.
paragraphs.zh: 投资者可能因为一家公司少人研究而称它为小公司。组合研究则需要别人可以重复的规则：固定美元门槛、市值百分位，或合格股票中最小的固定数量。即使在同一天，这些规则也会选出不同企业。

paragraphs.en: A smallest-400 rule fixes the number of holdings but lets its share of the market change as listings expand. A bottom-quintile rule fixes a fraction but lets the number and dollar size change. The share definition, exchange universe and historical eligibility belong in the definition too.
paragraphs.zh: 最小400只固定了持股数量，却会随上市公司增加而改变覆盖比例。最小五分之一固定比例，数量和美元规模则随之变化。股数口径、交易所范围与历史资格也都是定义的一部分。

title.en: Two lenses on the same evidence

paragraphs.en: Use the absolute buckets to ask how much daily trading activity accompanies a given dollar size. Switch to within-market quintiles to ask how the smallest local segment differs from larger local companies. A bottom quintile in one market need not fit the same dollar bucket in another.
paragraphs.zh: 绝对市值分组用来观察给定美元规模对应多少日常交易活动。市场内五分组用来比较当地最小一端与较大公司。一个市场的最小五分之一，未必落在另一个市场相同的美元区间。

paragraphs.en: The chart keeps one lagged traded-value measure while changing the grouping rule. That isolates a useful descriptive choice, but it does not harmonize listing rules, share classes or source histories. Common dates remove one obvious mismatch; they do not make the underlying samples identical.
paragraphs.zh: 图表保持滞后成交额指标不变，只切换分组方式。这有助于理解口径差别，但不能统一上市制度、股份类别与来源历史。共同日期消除了一项明显差异，不能让底层样本变成同一个股票池。

paragraphs.en: The literature raises quality and shell-value questions because market capitalization can travel with other characteristics. Our retained low-turnover association is a separate exploratory question. Without matched formation dates, weights and quality controls, a resemblance in direction is not a replication or an explanation.
paragraphs.zh: 文献提出质量和壳价值问题，因为市值常与其他特征同时变化。保留的低换手关联是另一项探索问题。若未对齐形成日、权重与质量控制，方向相似不能算复现，也不能算解释。

limitations.en: Japanese historical share counts are incomplete; common dates do not certify point-in-time eligibility.
limitations.zh: 日股历史股数不完整；共同日期不能认证历史时点资格。

nextSteps.en: Freeze size, share and eligibility rules before comparing returns on common support.
nextSteps.zh: 先冻结规模、股数与资格规则，再在共同样本比较收益。

title.en: What did the smallest portfolios endure?
title.zh: 最小市值组合经历了什么？

summary.en: Loss depth and time below a prior peak matter independently of a final return.
summary.zh: 损失深度与等待恢复的时间，应独立于期末收益审视。

question.en: How much could a rule lose, and how long did recovery take?
question.zh: 一条规则曾亏损多少，又等待多久才恢复？

conclusion.en: The retained reconstructions show deep losses and material waiting times. Accounting and eligibility limits block a claim of validated investable alpha.
conclusion.zh: 保留的重建显示深度损失与漫长等待；核算和资格限制阻止我们把它称为已验证的可投资超额收益。

title.en: Read the path before the endpoint

paragraphs.en: A high ending value does not tell an investor whether they could have held through the path. A drawdown measures the loss from a previous peak. An underwater duration measures the wait until that peak is recovered. A shallow but persistent decline can tie up capital differently from a sharp, quickly recovered fall.
paragraphs.zh: 较高的期末净值不能说明投资者能否熬过中途。回撤衡量相对前高的损失，水下期衡量等到重回前高所需时间。浅但持久的下跌，与猛烈但迅速恢复的下跌，会以不同方式占用资金。

paragraphs.en: The early 2008–2014 summaries report maximum drawdowns from roughly 60% to 69% across the retained 50 to 800-name rules. These are properties of the stated incomplete reconstruction, not estimates of a future loss limit. Wider portfolios did not mechanically eliminate the historical downside in this sample.
paragraphs.zh: 2008—2014年早期汇总中，保留的50至800只规则最大回撤约为60%至69%。这是注明存在缺项的重建结果，不能当作未来损失上限。在这个样本里，扩大持股数量并未机械消除历史下行风险。

paragraphs.en: The count selector describes early risk summaries. The actual NAV curve comes from a separate published 400-name reconstruction beginning in 2015. We have not filled missing curves from summary statistics, joined the two periods or inferred unobserved daily returns. Changing count therefore changes the early summary, not the later curve.
paragraphs.zh: 数量切换展示早期风险汇总。实际净值曲线来自另一份2015年开始的400只公开重建。我们没有根据汇总补造曲线、拼接区间或推断未观察的日收益。因此切换股票数改变早期汇总，不改变后期曲线。

paragraphs.en: In the early source, the longest underwater duration counts completed episodes only. Every count also has one episode still underwater at the sample end. That is right censoring: the eventual recovery is unknown, so the completed maximum cannot be read as a guaranteed waiting-time bound.
paragraphs.zh: 早期来源的最长水下期只统计已恢复区间。每组数量另有一个截至样本末仍未恢复的区间。这叫右删失：最终恢复时间未知，因此已完成区间的最大值不能理解为等待时间保证。

title.en: An audit can change the question

paragraphs.en: Historical eligibility, missing prices, suspensions and corporate actions can change both selected holdings and the account path. Matching a summary number does not recover the original runtime. Completed provider queries do not prove that all entitlements have been settled correctly. MC-C05 and MC-C06 retain those distinctions.
paragraphs.zh: 历史资格、缺失价格、停牌和公司行动可能同时改变选股与账户路径。汇总数接近不能找回原运行，供应商请求完成也不能证明所有权益已经正确结算。MC-C05与MC-C06保留了这些区别。

paragraphs.en: The next useful step is to reconcile raw shares and cash under fixed rules, then revisit the same historical episodes. A new calm month would add an observation; it would not erase a past loss or repair an unresolved ledger.
paragraphs.zh: 下一项有用工作是在固定规则下对齐真实股份与现金，再核对同一批历史案例。未来一个平静月份可以增加观察，却不会抹去过去损失，也不会修好尚未对齐的账本。

limitations.en: Early historical ST and suspension coverage is incomplete; the 400-name later NAV has no transaction-cost or capacity model.
limitations.zh: 早期历史ST与停牌覆盖不完整；后期400只净值没有成本或容量模型。

nextSteps.en: Reconcile raw-share and cash accounting before using reconstructed performance for an implementation decision.
nextSteps.zh: 在用重建表现作实施决策前，先核对真实股份与现金账本。

summary.en: Trading activity is a useful first screen; a sellable portfolio requires more evidence.
summary.zh: 成交活跃度是有用的初筛，但能卖出的组合需要更多证据。

question.en: What does a traded-value comparison establish about getting in and out?
question.zh: 成交额比较能告诉我们多少买入和退出能力？

conclusion.en: Reviewed aggregates describe activity across selected markets and periods. They do not establish spreads, fills, market impact or deployable capital.
conclusion.zh: 已审查汇总描述特定市场和区间的活跃度，不能确立价差、成交、冲击或可部署资金。

paragraphs.en: The displayed measure starts with each security’s mean daily traded value over 20 prior sessions, lagged by a session and converted into USD. The bucket median describes the middle observation. It is not the dollar amount a new investor can immediately buy or sell at the last price.
paragraphs.zh: 展示指标先计算每只证券此前20个交易日的日均成交额，再滞后一个交易日并换算美元。分组中位数描述中间观测，不是新增投资者能立刻按最新价买卖的金额。

paragraphs.en: For a historical period, the sample pools security-days. A company observed many days can appear many times; a unique-stock count answers a different question. Empty groups remain empty, and an observed zero is not interchangeable with a missing session.
paragraphs.zh: 历史区间汇集证券日。同一家公司在多个日期会出现多次，独立股票数回答另一问题。空分组仍为空，实际观测到的零成交也不能与缺失交易日混为一谈。

title.en: Dates and market names are not coverage guarantees
title.zh: 日期与市场名不等于覆盖保证

paragraphs.en: The available common periods include a shared 2025 snapshot and historical windows. The 2026 common period includes Hong Kong, China equities, China A-shares and Japan, ending in April; it does not contain US observations. The source retains different latest snapshots by market, which we do not combine into a same-day comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 可用共同区间包括2025年的同日快照及若干历史窗口。2026年共同区间包括中国香港港股、中国 A 股与日股，止于四月，不含美股观测。来源还保留各市场日期不同的最新快照，本页未把它们拼成同日比较。

paragraphs.en: Mainland coverage is Shanghai and Shenzhen, not every Chinese exchange. Japanese historical shares are incomplete and have not been certified against historical revisions. Even on common dates, listing coverage and valuation definitions differ. Use the chart to frame questions, not rank whole national markets as permanently liquid or illiquid.
paragraphs.zh: 内地覆盖沪深，不是所有中国交易所。日股历史股数不完整，也未认证历史修订安全。即使日期相同，上市范围和估值定义仍有差别。图表适合帮助提出问题，不宜据此给整个国家市场贴上永久流动或不流动的标签。

title.en: Move from a budget to a fill

paragraphs.en: A participation budget assumes an investor takes some fraction of market activity. It cannot establish that counterparties were available at an acceptable price or that a queued order filled. Spread, displayed depth, queue position, order policy and settlement each add constraints. A static depth calculation and a US NBBO spread are different measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 参与率预算假定投资者使用市场成交的一部分，不能证明可接受价格上存在对手方，也不能证明排队订单成交。价差、展示深度、排队位置、订单规则和结算都会加上约束。静态深度成本与美股NBBO价差也是不同指标。

paragraphs.en: The full-text readings of Amihud and Novy-Marx–Velikov now distinguish a return/volume proxy, fitted effective spreads and holding buffers. Their US results do not supply local cost constants. The quality-control paper remains an author-summary lead. No BMLL security-level observations are published.
paragraphs.zh: 本次全文阅读区分了Amihud的收益成交额代理、Novy-Marx与Velikov的有效价差估计及持有缓冲。美股结果不能提供本地成本常数。质量控制论文仍停留在作者摘要层面。本站不发布BMLL逐证券观测。

limitations.en: Historical point-in-time eligibility and executable capacity are not certified.
limitations.zh: 尚未认证历史时点资格与可执行容量。

nextSteps.en: Specify capital, order rules and account treatment, then compare calibrated fills on matched dates.
nextSteps.zh: 固定资金、订单规则与账户处理，再在对齐日期比较经过校准的成交。

title.en: What do the full papers actually test?

summary.en: Three full readings sharpen the comparison and expose missing inputs.
summary.zh: 三篇全文让比较更具体，也指出缺少哪些输入。

question.en: Which literature mechanisms can our retained evidence test?
question.zh: 保留的证据能检验哪些文献机制？

conclusion.en: Shell exclusions, illiquidity proxies and trading buffers require different data. Our present aggregates cannot identify these mechanisms.
conclusion.zh: 排除壳股、非流动性代理与持有缓冲各需不同数据。现有汇总无法识别这些机制。

paragraphs.en: Three papers have now been read in full. The literature records retain PDF hashes and page references. The China paper is the December 11, 2018 Wharton forthcoming manuscript; the cost study is the December 2014 NBER working paper. Results are attributed to those editions. Banz and the quality-control paper remain leads.
paragraphs.zh: 本次已完整阅读三篇论文，文献记录保留PDF哈希与页码。中国研究采用2018年12月11日Wharton待刊稿，成本研究采用2014年12月NBER工作论文。结论均对应实际阅读版本。Banz与质量控制论文仍是待深入阅读的线索。

title.en: Turn a comparison into a test

paragraphs.en: Our next tests must freeze input contracts first: historical eligibility and total shares for a tail exclusion; daily security returns and traded values for ILLIQ; holdings transitions and an order-cost policy for buffers. These are independent research plans, not completed replications. The literature cards give concise method and result notes.
paragraphs.zh: 后续检验先固定输入口径。尾部排除需要历史资格和总股数，ILLIQ需要逐证券日收益与成交额，持有缓冲需要持仓变动和订单成本规则。这些是独立研究计划，尚未完成复现。文献卡片提供简要方法与结果笔记。

limitations.en: A full reading upgrades reading status, not the stage of an empirical claim.
limitations.zh: 全文阅读提升阅读状态，不提升实证结论阶段。

nextSteps.en: Run matched protocols only after their required historical inputs are available.
nextSteps.zh: 取得所需历史输入后，再运行匹配方案。

title.en: Which losses disappear in a yearly return?
title.zh: 年度收益掩盖了哪些损失？

summary.en: An independent calculation exposes holding-window losses, recovery waits and endpoint censoring.
summary.zh: 独立计算展示持有窗口损失、恢复等待和期末删失。

question.en: How does changing the holding window change the historical risk description?
question.zh: 持有窗口改变后，历史风险如何变化？

conclusion.en: The frozen NAV spent 84.7% of observations below its running peak. A positive calendar year can contain a large, long-lived loss.
conclusion.zh: 冻结净值有84.7%的观测低于此前峰值。盈利的自然年也可能包含深且持久的损失。

title.en: One frozen series, a new calculation
title.zh: 同一冻结序列，新增计算

paragraphs.en: We independently derive 2,837 consecutive ratios from 2,838 NAV levels dated January 5, 2015 to September 4, 2026. No first-day return is invented. The script checks positive finite levels and strictly increasing dates. Observation steps are not calendar days; a dated NAV does not certify a filled trade.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从2015年1月5日至2026年9月4日的2838个净值，独立计算2837个相邻比值，不补造首日收益。脚本检查净值为有限正数、日期严格递增。观测间隔不等于自然日，带日期的净值也不能证明真实成交。

title.en: A profitable year can contain a crisis
title.zh: 年度盈利也可能经历危机

paragraphs.en: The 2024 last-observation return is +31.71%, but the January 3 peak fell 37.94% by February 6 and recovered only on September 30, 179 observation steps later. In 2015 the largest peak-to-trough loss was 51.27%, from June 11 to July 7; recovery occurred on November 19, 107 steps after the peak.
paragraphs.zh: 2024年末相对上年末增长31.71%，但1月3日高点至2月6日下跌37.94%，直到9月30日才恢复，距高点179个观测间隔。2015年最大峰谷损失为51.27%，发生在6月11日至7月7日，11月19日恢复，距高点107个间隔。

title.en: Holding windows are overlapping historical observations
title.zh: 持有窗口是重叠的历史观察

paragraphs.en: Among 2,817 overlapping 21-step windows, 36.17% lost money and the worst lost 45.40%. Among 2,586 overlapping 252-step windows, 7.54% lost money and the worst lost 29.96%. These are empirical frequencies along one reconstructed path, not independent trials or probabilities for a new investor.
paragraphs.zh: 2817个重叠的21间隔窗口中，36.17%亏损，最差亏45.40%。2586个252间隔窗口中，7.54%亏损，最差亏29.96%。这些是单条重建路径上的历史频率，既非独立试验，也非新投资者的未来亏损概率。

paragraphs.en: At the final observation, the February 24, 2026 peak remained unrecovered after 133 steps; its trough on July 23 was 29.33% below the peak. The eventual recovery time is unknown. Implied daily extremes of −14.82% and +15.68% are properties of the supplied NAV, requiring account and universe reconciliation before any implementation claim.
paragraphs.zh: 期末时，2026年2月24日高点已过133个间隔仍未恢复，7月23日谷底较高点低29.33%。最终恢复时间未知。净值隐含的单日极值为−14.82%与15.68%，属于来源路径的特征；讨论实施前仍需核对账户与股票池。

limitations.en: No transaction costs, risk-free series, benchmark, holdings or security-level accounting were added. Diagnostic return frequencies inherit all source reconstruction limitations.
limitations.zh: 本次未补充交易成本、无风险利率、基准、持仓或逐证券核算。诊断频率继承来源重建的全部限制。

nextSteps.en: Reconcile the dated extremes to raw-share and cash ledgers, then rerun the same diagnostics on a certified account path.
nextSteps.zh: 把极端日期与真实股份和现金账本对齐，再在通过核查的账户路径上重算。

literature.title: The relationship between return and market value of common stocks
literature.version: Journal article metadata; full text not reviewed

summary.en: Publisher abstract reports historical risk-adjusted size association and explicitly leaves size versus correlated characteristics unresolved.
summary.zh: 出版方摘要讨论历史风险调整后收益与规模的关联，也保留规模是否代理其他特征的问题。

question.en: Do we study the same universe, weighting, dates and risk adjustment? An A-share smallest-N portfolio is not a direct replication.
question.zh: 股票池、日期、权重与风险调整是否一致？A股最小N只组合并非直接复现。

literature.title: Size Matters, If You Control Your Junk
literature.version: Journal article metadata; full text not reviewed

summary.en: Authors argue that controlling for quality strengthens the size effect in their tested settings.
summary.zh: 作者机构的介绍认为，在其检验设定中控制质量后，规模效应更强。

question.en: Does a size association survive historical quality controls on a common sample? Do not imply our current low-turnover tests replicate this paper.
question.zh: 在共同历史样本加入质量控制后，规模关联是否仍存在？现有低换手检验并非本文复现。

literature.title: Size and value in China
literature.version: Wharton forthcoming manuscript, December 11, 2018; 56 PDF pages; printed pp. 1–55. Distinct from the 2019 JFE edition.

summary.en: Full text read, with edition, page references, method and limitations recorded below. No replication has been completed.
summary.zh: 已阅读所列版本全文，下列笔记记录页码、方法及限制。尚未完成复现。

question.en: What changes when we exclude the smallest tail under matched accounting? Historical shell-value results do not establish current post-reform mechanisms or explain all microcap returns.
question.zh: 在相同核算下排除最小一端，结果如何改变？不能据历史壳价值推断当前制度。

fulltext.edition: Wharton forthcoming manuscript, December 11, 2018; 56 PDF pages; printed pp. 1–55. Distinct from the 2019 JFE edition.

title.zh: 样本与构建 · 第4至5、12、25至28页

paragraphs.en: The 2000–2016 WIND sample excludes the bottom 30% by lagged size, recent listings and sparse trading histories. CH-3 uses monthly size/earnings-price sorts and total-A-share value weights.
paragraphs.zh: WIND样本覆盖2000至2016年，按滞后市值排除最小30%，另排除新股与交易记录不足的股票。CH-3每月按规模和盈利市值比分组，以全部A股市值加权。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 reports monthly SMB 1.03% and VMG 1.14%. Shell estimates use 133 reverse mergers and a perpetual-payoff approximation. The IPO-count coefficient has t = −1.53; its direction alone is weak evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 表3报告SMB与VMG月均收益1.03%和1.14%。壳价值估计依据133次借壳及永续收益近似。IPO数量系数的t值为−1.53，仅凭方向不足以确立关联。

limitations.en: Historical factor-model tests do not identify current shell values or prove a tradable smallest-400 return. Failure to reject alpha is not proof of explanation.
limitations.zh: 历史因子检验不能确定当前壳价值，也不能证明最小400只组合可以交易。未拒绝零alpha不等于证实解释成立。

literature.title: Illiquidity and stock returns: cross-section and time-series effects
literature.version: Journal of Financial Markets 5 (2002), pp. 31–56; 26 PDF pages, UPenn-hosted journal copy.

summary.en: Full text read, with edition, page references, method and limitations recorded below. No replication has been completed.
summary.zh: 已阅读所列版本全文，下列笔记记录页码、方法及限制。尚未完成复现。

question.en: How do low-frequency price-impact proxies relate to observed NBBO spread and quote age? They are distinct quantities and not causal impact estimates.
question.zh: 低频价格冲击代理与NBBO价差、报价年龄如何关联？它们不能当作因果冲击估计。

fulltext.edition: Journal of Financial Markets 5 (2002), pp. 31–56; 26 PDF pages, UPenn-hosted journal copy.

title.zh: 指标与检验 · 第34至41页

paragraphs.en: ILLIQ averages daily absolute return divided by dollar volume. NYSE monthly cross-sections cover 1964–1997 using lagged characteristics, delisting adjustments, >200 prior-year observations, price >$5 and tail trimming.
paragraphs.zh: ILLIQ将日绝对收益除以当日美元成交额，再取平均。NYSE月度截面覆盖1964至1997年，使用滞后特征并调整退市收益，要求前一年超过200个观测、股价高于5美元，另剔除极端值。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 retains a positive ILLIQ coefficient with size controls (0.112, t = 5.39). Autoregressive annual and monthly tests distinguish anticipated illiquidity from shocks; the former has a positive return association, the latter a negative contemporaneous association.
paragraphs.zh: 表2控制规模后，ILLIQ系数仍为正，数值0.112，t值5.39。年度与月度自回归检验区分预期非流动性与意外变化，前者与收益正相关，后者与同期收益负相关。

limitations.en: This coarse proxy is neither an executable spread nor causal order impact; NYSE filters omit important parts of a modern microcap universe.

question.zh: 怎样区分持有缓冲、信号换手和真实交易换手？美股成本不能当作当下A股常数。

fulltext.edition: NBER Working Paper 20721, December 2014; 61 PDF pages, printed pp. 1–59; not the later journal edition.

title.zh: 成本与评价 · 第4至16页

paragraphs.en: The paper tests 23 US anomalies with NYSE breakpoints and value weights. Costs use Bayesian effective-spread estimates and matching for missing estimates. Its generalized alpha evaluates incremental investment opportunity after costs.
paragraphs.zh: 论文用NYSE断点和市值权重检验23个美股异象。成本依据贝叶斯有效价差估计，缺失值通过匹配补足。广义alpha评价扣费后新增的投资机会。

title.zh: 持有缓冲 · 第29至36、42至44页

paragraphs.en: Separate entry/exit ranks reduce unnecessary trading. Reported mean turnover and cost reductions are 41% and 42%. Table 13 shows the microcap high-frequency combination changing from +1.77% gross to −0.66% net monthly.
paragraphs.zh: 买入与退出采用不同排名门槛，减少无须发生的交易。论文报告平均换手和成本分别下降41%和42%。表13的微盘高频组合月均收益从扣费前1.77%降至扣费后−0.66%。

limitations.en: Effective spreads omit large-order price impact. Results and fitted costs are historical US estimates, not present China A-share capacity estimates.
limitations.zh: 有效价差未计大额订单冲击。结果和拟合成本属于历史美股估计，不能当作当前中国 A 股容量。

statement.zh: 保留的重建显示较大损失与等待时间；可投资性未明，不会抹去历史风险。

description.zh: 21个交易日区间在显式卖出规则下对齐79笔独立核查成交；未认证完整历史核算。

description.en: Three identified paper editions were read in full and a deterministic script recomputed holding-window and recovery diagnostics from the frozen public NAV. This adds computations, not a new portfolio reconstruction.

reason.en: Full-text method comparison: the existing low-share-turnover association is a stock characteristic; portfolio trading turnover requires holdings transitions. NAV levels cannot test a buy/hold buffer. The necessary paired replay is unrun.
reason.zh: 全文方法对照显示，已有低换手关联描述股票特征，组合交易换手需要持仓变动。净值无法检验持有缓冲，需要的配对重放尚未运行。
